state.seed_assertion: Costs and benefits of mitigating measures should be considered when deciding whether to implement them.

sentences.1: Costs and benefits of mitigating measures should be considered when deciding whether to implement them.
sentences.2: You can take into account the costs and benefits of each measure when deciding whether or not they are appropriate.
sentences.3: If you have decided to accept a high risk, either because it is not possible to mitigate or because the costs of mitigation are too high, you must consult the ICO before you go ahead with the processing.
sentences.4: If high risk is accepted because mitigation is impossible or costs are too high, ICO consultation is mandatory before processing proceeds.
sentences.5: Processing may only be carried out after implementing the recommendations in the CNPD's opinion following prior consultation.
sentences.6: Processing may only be carried out after implementing the recommandations in the opinion of the CNPD.
sentences.7: You should identify any action points and who is responsible for implementing them.
sentences.8: DPIAs are legally required for high-risk processing but can also bring broader compliance, financial and reputational benefits.
sentences.9: Organizations must always conduct a DPIA if they plan to use profiling, automated decision-making or special category data to help make decisions on someone's access to a service, opportunity or benefit.
sentences.10: Automated decision-making about an individual's access to products, services, opportunities, or benefits requires a DPIA.
sentences.11: The ICO requires DPIAs for profiling or special category data use in deciding access to services.
